source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet screenshot, limits section only

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: No indeterminate form: every term is a continuous exponential/polynomial product, so evaluate by direct substitution at x=0 (2·1-0·1+2·1+4).

questions.label: b
questions.technique: ∞/∞ at infinity: for a rational function, the limit of the ratio of same-degree polynomials equals the ratio of leading coefficients. Set 8/a=1 and solve for a.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: ∞-∞ at negative infinity. Multiply and divide by the conjugate sqrt(x^2+9)-x: numerator collapses to the constant 9, giving 9/(sqrt(x^2+9)-x). As x→-∞, sqrt(x^2+9)~-x so the denominator → +∞, sending the ratio to 0.

questions.label: d
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Factor sin x(1-cos x) from the numerator, then replace 1-cos x with the half-angle form 2sin^2(x/2). Split the expression into (sin x/x)·(2sin^2(x/2))/x^2 and apply the sinc limit twice.
